title: Tactical Launch Slate + KPI Synthesis for Q3 Dedicated Rollout
content:
Purpose:
A compact, tactical slate to track the Q3 Dedicated capacity rollout. This sheet synthesizes top-level KPIs, critical pre-launch signals, dependency timelines, and hard contingency triggers so on-call, product ops, and release engineers can make fast decisions during the 6-week runway.

Scope and intended use:
- Audience: product-ops leads, release engineers, SRE on-call, sales enablement.
- Use cadence: weekly updates + daily signal checks during launch freeze.
- Outputs: go/no-go decision recommendation, prioritized mitigation actions, and a single source of truth for signal owners.

Runway phases (6 weeks):
- Phase 0 (T-6 to T-4 weeks) => Prep: final config matrix, docs, canary plan.
- Phase 1 (T-4 to T-2 weeks) => Integration smoke: running traffic with feature flags off, verify perf baselines.
- Phase 2 (T-2 to T-0 weeks) => Canary & ops runbook drill, chatops play rehearsals.
- Phase 3 (T-0 to T+2 weeks) => Staged ramp + fallback validation.

KPI signal catalog (primary signals to observe each day):
- Latency p95 (ms) | Target: <= 220ms | Warning: 250–300ms | Critical: >300ms -> Action: slow-path rollbacks / scale up.
- Token cost per 1k tokens ($) | Target: <= 0.045 | Warning: 0.046–0.06 | Critical: >0.06 -> Action: throttle non-essential routes / switch quantized model.
- Error rate (5xx% per minute) | Target: <0.05% | Warning: 0.05–0.5% | Critical: >0.5% -> Action: circuit-breaker + fallback model.
- Throughput (requests/s sustained) | Expected baseline: 120 r/s | Warning: drop >20% | Critical: drop >40% -> Action: prioritize high-value routes, enable reserved capacity burst.
- Customer-impacting SLO breaches (count) | Target: 0/day | Warning: 1/day | Critical: >=2/day -> Action: page ops lead / notify sales.

Dependency timeline (condensed):
- Model packaging (quantized variant) -> owner: Applied ML (Diego P) -> due: T-21 days -> blocker?: yes if packaging fails.
- Autoscale policy config -> owner: Infra (Connor B) -> due: T-14 days -> test: load test w/ 2x expected peak.
- Documentation & runbook publication -> owner: Product-ops (Maya O) -> due: T-10 days -> must include rollback steps.

Hard contingency thresholds and playbook (if any critical signal trips):
- If latency p95 > 300ms sustained for 5 minutes:
  - Immediate: flip to previous model variant (automated fallback) and open incident with SRE.
  - Notify: #prod-ops, #sre-oncall, assigned product manager.
  - Post-incident: perform trobleshoot checklist, capture heap/cpu profiles, run limited replay tests.

- If token cost >0.06 for 30m:
  - Immediate: disable non-billable experimental routes; enable short-term batching and reconfigure KV cache TTL to default aggressive.
  - Medium: examine candidate quantization settings; contact Applied ML for emergency optimization window.

Owners & RAG responsibilities (live owner list for daily stand):
- Release lead: Aisha Romero (overall decision authority).
- Ops liaison: Connor Blake (scale ops).
- Metrics & dashboards: Maya O'Neill (observability).
- Model owner: Diego Park (model variants, quality gating).

Daily tracker template (copy into daily notes):
- Date:
- Runway phase:
- KPIs (p95 latency, error%, throughput, token cost) -> current / target / delta
- Top 3 anomalies observed
- Actions taken (owner + ETA)
- Decision recommendation (green/amber/red) + rationale

Launch checklist (short):
- [ ] Final quantized package verified against baseline perf.
- [ ] Autoscale policies reviewed & smoke-tested.
- [ ] Canary traffic routing plan published and Slack alerts wired.
- [ ] Runbook includes exact rollback API calls and keys.
- [ ] Sales/CS notified of staged ramp timeline and communication templates.

Open questions / known risks:
- Risk: Variant quality drift during long-tailed prompts. Mitigation: attach a small prompt-set regression test to canary traffic.
- Question: Do we have a pre-approved discount window for cost spikes with finance? (action: Aisha to confirm).
- Risk: Cross-region fallback latency — need an SLI for cross-region failover.

Appendix: quick reference commands & links (keeps short for on-call)
- Canary toggle: /api/v1/feature/canary/{toggle} -> Engineering runbook link: CONFLUENCE-PLAT-987
- Incident channel: #prod-ops-incidents
- Key runbook section: rollback -> search for 'rollback-short-path' in runbook doc

Notes to self (working items):
- Revisit threshold math for token cost after load test on T-21.
- Add a small synthetic for hallucination rate in post-launch telemetry (placeholder metric).

Status log (history):
- 2025-02-12: initial draft; owners assigned.
- 2025-02-18: autoscale schema updated after infra walkthrough.
- 2025-03-01: moved to in_review; awaiting security signoff for dedicated network policy.

-- end sheet --
